_comment: USD per 1,000,000 tokens, from model-picker/skills/model-picker/reference/models-condensed.md (snapshot 2026-09-13). Keys must match the model id string Claude Code writes into the transcript (message.model on assistant turns) — see README 'Adding or updating a model'. cache_read is per-model because the ratio to input is not uniform (Fable is 0.025x). Cache writes are priced as a multiple of input by TTL. 'fast' rates apply when usage.speed == 'fast'; cache rates scale by the same ratio. 'long_context' names an entry in the top-level long_context table. claude_code_fallback_model is the entry whose rates Claude Code's own cost total applies to model ids it doesn't recognise (verified: Sonnet rates).
